bio: Diners come here to enjoy the friendly and vibrant atmosphere and delicious food. In the evening, you can compose your own seven-course set menu from the featured dishes or order à la carte. Alternatively, there is a surprise menu comprising three to five courses as well as a set menu of Japanese cuisine. At lunchtime, they serve a reasonably priced set menu that changes on a daily basis, the weekly gourmet set menu and a range of à la carte classics such as beef carpaccio, Kalbsrahmbeuschel (calf lights ragout) or Wiener schnitzel, as well as modern fare such as sea bass with saffron foam. In summer, you can sit on the terrace facing a small square laid out like a park. Tip: Your best bet for parking is the underground car park Am Kirchplatz....
